CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_owner_outreach_report(p_actor uuid, p_days integer DEFAULT 30, p_include_owner boolean DEFAULT false, p_query text DEFAULT ''::text, p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_status text DEFAULT 'all'::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
 owner_id constant uuid:='592171a0-2bb9-484e-8c9a-dd5d2b43b5f7';
 end_at timestamptz:=now();start_at timestamptz;result jsonb;
begin
 if p_actor is distinct from owner_id then raise exception 'Owner required' using errcode='42501';end if;
 if p_days is null or p_days not in (1,7,30) or p_include_owner is null
  or p_query is null or length(p_query)>100 or p_page is null or p_page not between 1 and 100000
  or p_status is null or p_status not in ('all','responded','interested','queued','held')
 then raise exception 'Invalid report filters';end if;
 start_at:=((end_at at time zone 'America/Chicago')::date-(p_days-1))::timestamp at time zone 'America/Chicago';
 with accounts as materialized (
  select a.id,a.bot_paused,coalesce(nullif(a.legal_name,''),nullif(a.assistant_name,''),'Customer account') label
  from public.icash_accounts a
  where (p_include_owner or a.owner_user_id<>owner_id)
   and (not exists(select 1 from public.icash_funding_orders f where f.account_id=a.id and f.mode='test' and f.state='paid')
    or exists(select 1 from public.icash_funding_orders f where f.account_id=a.id and f.mode='live' and f.state='paid'))
 ), screens as materialized (
  select s.id,s.account_id,s.state,s.created_at,s.completed_at,a.label,a.bot_paused,
   coalesce(nullif(s.result->'property'->>'address',''),nullif(s.snapshot->>'address',''),'Address pending') address,
   coalesce(s.state='complete' and s.result->'financialCheck'->>'status'='eligible'
    and s.snapshot->>'propertyType'='house' and s.snapshot->>'propertyId'=s.result->'property'->>'propertyId',false) eligible
  from public.icash_screening_jobs s join accounts a on a.id=s.account_id
  where s.event_key like 'discovery:%' and s.snapshot->'sellerRequest' is null
   and coalesce(s.snapshot->>'practice','false')<>'true'
   and coalesce(s.snapshot->>'propertyId','') not like 'practice_%' and s.created_at<end_at
 ), voice as materialized (
  -- One row per job, even if a historical conversation has multiple projections.
  select distinct on (j.id) j.id,s.id screening_id,j.state,j.created_at,
   (nullif(j.provider_call_sid,'') is not null or nullif(r.call_sid,'') is not null or nullif(c.conversation_id,'') is not null) attempted,
   coalesce(r.dial_claimed_at,sp.dispatched_at,c.created_at) attempt_at,
   c.state='complete' and nullif(c.conversation_id,'') is not null as ai_complete,c.completed_at,
   c.state='complete' and nullif(c.conversation_id,'') is not null and public.icash_call_has_seller_response(c.result) responded,
   c.state='complete' and nullif(c.conversation_id,'') is not null and public.icash_call_has_seller_response(c.result)
    and c.result->'interested'='true'::jsonb and public.icash_seller_call_disposition(c.result) is null interested,
   nullif(c.conversation_id,'') is not null and (c.result->'optedOut'='true'::jsonb or public.icash_seller_call_disposition(c.result)='opt_out') opted_out,
   tr.receipt->>'status' terminal_status
  from public.icash_voice_jobs j
  left join public.icash_operational_contacts oc on oc.id=j.operational_contact_id and oc.account_id=j.account_id and oc.channel='voice'
  left join public.icash_contact_permissions cp on cp.id=j.permission_id and cp.account_id=j.account_id and cp.party='seller'
  join screens s on s.id=coalesce(oc.screening_id,cp.screening_id) and s.account_id=j.account_id
  left join public.icash_operation_spend sp on sp.account_id=j.account_id and sp.operation_key='voice:'||j.id
  left join public.icash_call_recordings r on r.voice_job_id=j.id and r.account_id=j.account_id
   and r.screening_id=s.id and r.operation_key='voice:'||j.id
  left join public.icash_live_conversations c on c.account_id=j.account_id and c.screening_id=s.id
   and c.operation_key='voice:'||j.id and c.party='seller' and c.contact_key=coalesce(oc.contact_key,cp.contact_key)
  left join public.icash_recorded_gate_terminal_receipts tr on tr.recording_id=r.id
   and tr.account_id=r.account_id and tr.call_sid=r.call_sid and tr.receipt->>'sid'=r.call_sid
  where j.created_at<end_at
  order by j.id,c.completed_at desc nulls last,c.id desc
 ), voice_stats as materialized (
  select screening_id,
   count(*) filter(where attempted and attempt_at>=start_at and attempt_at<end_at) calls,
   count(*) filter(where ai_complete and completed_at>=start_at and completed_at<end_at) conversations,
   count(*) filter(where responded and completed_at>=start_at and completed_at<end_at) responses,
   count(*) filter(where attempted and attempt_at>=start_at and attempt_at<end_at and terminal_status='no-answer') unanswered,
   count(*) filter(where attempted and attempt_at>=start_at and attempt_at<end_at and terminal_status='busy') busy,
   count(*) filter(where attempted and attempt_at>=start_at and attempt_at<end_at and terminal_status in ('failed','canceled')) failed,
   count(*) filter(where not attempted and state in ('ready','issued')) queued,
   count(*) filter(where not attempted and state='held') held,
   bool_or(responded and completed_at<end_at) responded,
   bool_or(interested and completed_at<end_at) interested,
   bool_or(opted_out and completed_at<end_at) opted_out,
   bool_or(responded and completed_at>=start_at and completed_at<end_at) response_in_period,
   bool_or(interested and completed_at>=start_at and completed_at<end_at) interest_in_period,
   max(greatest(created_at,case when attempted and attempt_at<end_at then attempt_at end,
    case when completed_at<end_at then completed_at end)) latest_at
  from voice group by screening_id
 ), texts as materialized (
  select m.id,s.id screening_id,m.state,m.direction,m.provider_id,m.event_id,m.created_at,m.last_delivery_at,
   coalesce(sp.dispatched_at,m.last_delivery_at) sent_at,
   m.direction='incoming' and m.state='received' and (nullif(m.provider_id,'') is not null or nullif(m.event_id,'') is not null) replied,
   m.direction='incoming' and m.state='received' and (nullif(m.provider_id,'') is not null or nullif(m.event_id,'') is not null)
    and public.icash_seller_contact_stop(m.body) opted_out
  from screens s join public.icash_deal_files d on d.screening_id=s.id and d.account_id=s.account_id
  join public.icash_text_threads t on t.deal_id=d.id and t.account_id=d.account_id and t.party='seller'
  join public.icash_text_messages m on m.thread_id=t.id and m.account_id=t.account_id
  left join public.icash_operation_spend sp on sp.account_id=m.account_id and sp.operation_key='text:'||m.id
  where m.created_at<end_at
 ), text_stats as materialized (
  select screening_id,
   count(*) filter(where direction='outgoing' and nullif(provider_id,'') is not null and sent_at>=start_at and sent_at<end_at) accepted,
   count(*) filter(where direction='outgoing' and state='delivered' and nullif(provider_id,'') is not null
    and last_delivery_at>=start_at and last_delivery_at<end_at) delivered,
   count(*) filter(where replied and created_at>=start_at) replies,
   count(*) filter(where direction='outgoing' and provider_id is null and state='ready') queued,
   count(*) filter(where direction='outgoing' and provider_id is null and state='needs_review') held,
   bool_or(replied) responded,bool_or(opted_out) opted_out,
   bool_or(replied and created_at>=start_at) response_in_period,
   max(greatest(created_at,case when sent_at<end_at then sent_at end,case when last_delivery_at<end_at then last_delivery_at end)) latest_at
  from texts group by screening_id
 ), properties as materialized (
  select s.*,
   coalesce(v.calls,0) calls,coalesce(v.conversations,0) conversations,coalesce(v.responses,0) call_responses,
   coalesce(v.unanswered,0) unanswered,coalesce(v.busy,0) busy,coalesce(v.failed,0) failed,
   coalesce(v.queued,0) queued_calls,coalesce(v.held,0) held_calls,
   coalesce(t.accepted,0) texts_accepted,coalesce(t.delivered,0) texts_delivered,coalesce(t.replies,0) text_replies,
   coalesce(t.queued,0) queued_texts,coalesce(t.held,0) held_texts,
   coalesce(v.responded,false) or coalesce(t.responded,false) responded,
   coalesce(v.opted_out,false) or coalesce(t.opted_out,false) opted_out,
   coalesce(v.interested,false) and not(coalesce(v.opted_out,false) or coalesce(t.opted_out,false)) interested,
   coalesce(v.response_in_period,false) or coalesce(t.response_in_period,false) response_in_period,
   coalesce(v.interest_in_period,false) and not(coalesce(v.opted_out,false) or coalesce(t.opted_out,false)) interest_in_period,
   greatest(s.created_at,case when s.completed_at<end_at then s.completed_at end,v.latest_at,t.latest_at) latest_at
  from screens s left join voice_stats v on v.screening_id=s.id left join text_stats t on t.screening_id=s.id
 ), recent as materialized (
  select * from properties where latest_at>=start_at or queued_calls+queued_texts+held_calls+held_texts>0
 ), matching as materialized (
  select * from recent where (trim(p_query)='' or position(lower(trim(p_query)) in lower(address||' '||label||' '||account_id::text))>0)
   and case p_status when 'responded' then responded when 'interested' then interested
    when 'queued' then queued_calls+queued_texts>0 when 'held' then held_calls+held_texts>0 else true end
 ), page_rows as (
  select * from matching order by interested desc,responded desc,latest_at desc,id desc limit 25 offset (p_page-1)*25
 )
 select jsonb_build_object('days',p_days,'includeOwner',p_include_owner,'query',trim(p_query),'page',p_page,'status',p_status,
  'pageSize',25,'timezone','America/Chicago','startAt',start_at,'endAt',end_at,
  'matchedCount',(select count(*) from matching),
  'totals',(select jsonb_build_object(
   'researched',count(*) filter(where state='complete' and completed_at>=start_at and completed_at<end_at),
   'eligible',count(*) filter(where eligible and completed_at>=start_at and completed_at<end_at),
   'accounts',count(distinct account_id) filter(where calls+texts_accepted>0),
   'calls',coalesce(sum(calls),0),'conversations',coalesce(sum(conversations),0),'callResponses',coalesce(sum(call_responses),0),
   'unanswered',coalesce(sum(unanswered),0),'busy',coalesce(sum(busy),0),'failed',coalesce(sum(failed),0),
   'textsAccepted',coalesce(sum(texts_accepted),0),'textsDelivered',coalesce(sum(texts_delivered),0),'textReplies',coalesce(sum(text_replies),0),
   'respondedProperties',count(*) filter(where response_in_period),'interestedProperties',count(*) filter(where interest_in_period),
   'queuedCalls',coalesce(sum(queued_calls),0),'queuedTexts',coalesce(sum(queued_texts),0),
   'heldCalls',coalesce(sum(held_calls),0),'heldTexts',coalesce(sum(held_texts),0)) from properties),
  'leads',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
   'id',id,'accountId',account_id,'account',label,'address',address,'paused',bot_paused,'eligible',eligible,
   'responded',responded,'interested',interested,'optedOut',opted_out,'latestAt',latest_at,
   'calls',calls,'conversations',conversations,'callResponses',call_responses,'unanswered',unanswered,'busy',busy,'failed',failed,
   'textsAccepted',texts_accepted,'textsDelivered',texts_delivered,'textReplies',text_replies,
   'queuedCalls',queued_calls,'queuedTexts',queued_texts,'heldCalls',held_calls,'heldTexts',held_texts
  ) order by interested desc,responded desc,latest_at desc,id desc) from page_rows),'[]'::jsonb)
 ) into result;
 return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_refresh_learning_before_ranker(p_account uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare zip_code text;s jsonb;
begin
 perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(p_account::text,81021));
 perform public.icash_refresh_opportunity_outcomes(p_account);
 delete from public.icash_learning_rollups where account_id=p_account;
 for zip_code in select distinct zip from public.icash_discovery_filter_pages where account_id=p_account and created_at>now()-interval '90 days' loop
  for s in select value from jsonb_array_elements(public.icash_discovery_filter_feedback(p_account,zip_code)) loop
   insert into public.icash_learning_rollups(account_id,domain,context,market,variant,attempts,pending,positive,opted_out,cost_cents,costs_complete,contract_trials,contracts,closing_trials,closings)
   select p_account,'seller_filters','seller-filters-v1',zip_code,s->>'strategy',(s->>'attempted')::bigint,(s->>'pendingAttempts')::bigint,(s->>'interested')::bigint,(s->>'optedOut')::bigint,(s->>'costCents')::bigint,(s->>'costsComplete')::boolean,
    count(*) filter(where p.created_at<=now()-interval '30 days'),
    count(*) filter(where p.created_at<=now()-interval '30 days' and e.purchase_at between p.created_at and p.created_at+interval '30 days'),
    count(*) filter(where p.created_at<=now()-interval '60 days'),
    count(*) filter(where p.created_at<=now()-interval '60 days' and e.closed_at between p.created_at and p.created_at+interval '60 days')
   from public.icash_discovery_filter_pages p join public.icash_discovery_filter_attribution a on a.operation_key=p.operation_key and a.account_id=p.account_id
   left join public.icash_learning_deal_outcomes(p_account) e on e.screening_id=a.screening_id
   where p.account_id=p_account and p.zip=zip_code and p.plan->>'version'='seller-filters-v1' and p.plan->>'strategy'=s->>'strategy' and p.created_at between now()-interval '90 days' and now();
  end loop;
 end loop;
 -- Market learning uses verified signatures, never an optimistic deal stage.
 insert into public.icash_learning_rollups(account_id,domain,context,market,variant,attempts,pending,positive,opted_out,contract_trials,contracts,closing_trials,closings,costs_complete)
 select p_account,'market','research-v1',o.zip,'market',count(*),0,count(*) filter(where o.interested and not o.opted_out),count(*) filter(where o.opted_out),
 count(*) filter(where o.discovered_at<=now()-interval '30 days'),count(*) filter(where o.discovered_at<=now()-interval '30 days' and e.purchase_at between o.discovered_at and o.discovered_at+interval '30 days'),
 count(*) filter(where o.discovered_at<=now()-interval '60 days'),count(*) filter(where o.discovered_at<=now()-interval '60 days' and e.closed_at between o.discovered_at and o.discovered_at+interval '60 days'),false
 from public.icash_opportunity_outcomes o left join public.icash_learning_deal_outcomes(p_account) e on e.screening_id=o.screening_id
 where o.account_id=p_account and o.research_source and o.discovered_at between now()-interval '90 days' and now()-interval '72 hours' group by o.zip;
 -- Recovery: one first delivered attempt per deal/context, 30-day contract and
 -- 60-day closing windows. Disabled copy remains disabled.
 insert into public.icash_learning_rollups(account_id,domain,context,market,variant,attempts,pending,positive,opted_out,contract_trials,contracts,closing_trials,closings,cost_cents,costs_complete)
 select p_account,'seller_recovery',a.reason||':'||a.stage||':'||a.source_channel,'*',a.variant,count(*),count(*) filter(where a.delivered_at>now()-interval '30 days'),
 count(*) filter(where a.delivered_at<=now()-interval '30 days' and a.responded_at between a.delivered_at and a.delivered_at+interval '30 days' and a.opted_out_at is null),count(*) filter(where a.opted_out_at is not null),
 count(*) filter(where a.delivered_at<=now()-interval '30 days'),count(*) filter(where a.delivered_at<=now()-interval '30 days' and e.purchase_at between a.delivered_at and a.delivered_at+interval '30 days'),
 count(*) filter(where a.delivered_at<=now()-interval '60 days'),count(*) filter(where a.delivered_at<=now()-interval '60 days' and e.closed_at between a.delivered_at and a.delivered_at+interval '60 days'),
 coalesce(sum(o.charged_cents) filter(where o.state='settled'),0),bool_and(o.state='settled' and o.charged_cents is not null) is true
 from (select distinct on (deal_id,reason,stage,source_channel) * from public.icash_seller_recovery_attempts where account_id=p_account and delivered_at between now()-interval '180 days' and now() order by deal_id,reason,stage,source_channel,delivered_at,gap_id) a
 join public.icash_learning_deal_outcomes(p_account) e on e.deal_id=a.deal_id
 left join public.icash_operation_spend o on o.account_id=p_account and o.operation_key='text:'||a.message_id group by a.reason,a.stage,a.source_channel,a.variant;
 -- Versioned seller texts count confirmed selling interest, never ownership replies.
 perform public.icash_refresh_seller_interest(p_account);
 -- Only prospective, actually dispatched versioned call assignments count.
 insert into public.icash_learning_rollups(account_id,domain,context,market,variant,attempts,pending,positive,opted_out,contract_trials,contracts,closing_trials,closings,cost_cents,costs_complete)
 select p_account,'seller_calls',a.context,'*',a.variant,count(*),count(*) filter(where c.created_at>now()-interval '72 hours'),
 count(*) filter(where c.created_at<=now()-interval '72 hours' and c.state='complete' and c.completed_at<=c.created_at+interval '72 hours' and c.result->'interested'='true'::jsonb and coalesce(c.result->>'optedOut','false')<>'true'),
 count(*) filter(where c.result->'optedOut'='true'::jsonb),count(*) filter(where c.created_at<=now()-interval '30 days'),count(*) filter(where c.created_at<=now()-interval '30 days' and e.purchase_at between c.created_at and c.created_at+interval '30 days'),
 count(*) filter(where c.created_at<=now()-interval '60 days'),count(*) filter(where c.created_at<=now()-interval '60 days' and e.closed_at between c.created_at and c.created_at+interval '60 days'),
 coalesce(sum(o.charged_cents) filter(where o.state='settled'),0),bool_and(o.state='settled' and o.charged_cents is not null) is true
 from public.icash_learning_assignments a join lateral(select c.* from public.icash_live_conversations c where c.account_id=a.account_id and c.screening_id::text||':'||c.contact_key=a.subject and c.strategy_key=a.variant and c.party='seller' and c.conversation_id is not null and c.created_at>=a.created_at and exists(select 1 from public.icash_call_recordings r where r.operation_key=c.operation_key and r.account_id=c.account_id and r.call_context->>'strategyKey'=a.variant and position('REVIEWED INTEREST QUESTION (shared-v1/'||a.context||'):' in r.call_context->>'prompt')>0) order by c.created_at,c.id limit 1) c on true
 join public.icash_learning_deal_outcomes(p_account) e on e.screening_id=c.screening_id
 join public.icash_operation_spend o on o.operation_key=c.operation_key and o.account_id=p_account and o.dispatched_at is not null
 where a.account_id=p_account and a.domain='seller_calls' and a.policy_version='shared-v1'
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_live_conversations earlier join public.icash_call_recordings er on er.account_id=earlier.account_id and er.operation_key=earlier.operation_key where earlier.account_id=p_account and earlier.screening_id=c.screening_id and earlier.party='seller' and earlier.conversation_id is not null and row(earlier.created_at,earlier.id)<row(c.created_at,c.id) and position('REVIEWED INTEREST QUESTION (shared-v1/' in er.call_context->>'prompt')>0) and c.created_at between now()-interval '180 days' and now() group by a.context,a.variant;
 -- Buyer policies are assigned per deal/revision. Qualification is an explicit
 -- reviewed buyer match; an owner lookup or an email click is not qualification.
 insert into public.icash_learning_rollups(account_id,domain,context,market,variant,attempts,pending,positive,opted_out,contract_trials,contracts,closing_trials,closings,cost_cents,costs_complete)
 select p_account,'buyer_search','order-v1',a.market,a.variant,count(*),count(*) filter(where first_receipt.at>now()-interval '30 days'),
 count(*) filter(where first_receipt.at<=now()-interval '30 days' and exists(select 1 from public.icash_buyer_matches m where m.deal_id=d.id and m.ready and m.qualification_request_id is not null and m.created_at between first_receipt.at and first_receipt.at+interval '30 days')),0,
 count(*) filter(where first_receipt.at<=now()-interval '30 days'),count(*) filter(where first_receipt.at<=now()-interval '30 days' and e.assignment_at between first_receipt.at and first_receipt.at+interval '30 days'),
 count(*) filter(where first_receipt.at<=now()-interval '60 days'),count(*) filter(where first_receipt.at<=now()-interval '60 days' and e.closed_at between first_receipt.at and first_receipt.at+interval '60 days'),coalesce(sum(cost.cents),0),bool_and(cost.complete) is true
 from public.icash_learning_assignments a join public.icash_deal_files d on d.account_id=a.account_id and a.subject like d.id::text||':%'
 join public.icash_learning_deal_outcomes(p_account) e on e.deal_id=d.id
 join lateral(select min(r.created_at) at from public.icash_buyer_search_receipts r where r.deal_id=d.id and a.subject=d.id::text||':'||r.revision and r.created_at>=a.created_at) first_receipt on first_receipt.at is not null
 cross join lateral(select coalesce(sum(o.charged_cents) filter(where o.state='settled'),0) cents,bool_and(case when r.operation_key is null then r.receipt->'emptyEstimate'='true'::jsonb else o.state='settled' and o.charged_cents is not null end) complete from public.icash_buyer_search_receipts r left join public.icash_operation_spend o on o.operation_key=r.operation_key and o.account_id=p_account where r.deal_id=d.id and a.subject=d.id::text||':'||r.revision) cost
 where a.account_id=p_account and a.domain='buyer_search' and a.policy_version='shared-v1' and a.context='order-v1' and first_receipt.at between now()-interval '180 days' and now() group by a.market,a.variant;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_refresh_opportunity_outcomes(p_account uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare last_refresh timestamptz;
begin
 if p_account is null or not pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(p_account::text,7319)) then return;end if;
 select refreshed_at into last_refresh from public.icash_opportunity_refreshes where account_id=p_account;
 if last_refresh>now()-interval '20 seconds' then return;end if;
 last_refresh:=coalesce(last_refresh,'-infinity'::timestamptz);
 -- Recompute changed properties only. A growing history must not make every
 -- workspace refresh rescan all transcripts and messages.
 with changed as (
  select s.id from public.icash_screening_jobs s left join public.icash_opportunity_outcomes o on o.screening_id=s.id and o.account_id=s.account_id
   where s.account_id=p_account and s.state='complete' and (o.screening_id is null or s.completed_at>=last_refresh)
  union select c.screening_id from public.icash_live_conversations c left join public.icash_operation_spend o on o.operation_key=c.operation_key and o.account_id=c.account_id
   where c.account_id=p_account and (c.created_at>=last_refresh or c.completed_at>=last_refresh or o.settled_at>=last_refresh)
  union select d.screening_id from public.icash_deal_files d join public.icash_text_threads t on t.account_id=d.account_id and t.deal_id=d.id
   join public.icash_text_messages m on m.account_id=t.account_id and m.thread_id=t.id
   left join public.icash_operation_spend o on o.account_id=m.account_id and o.operation_key='text:'||m.id
   where d.account_id=p_account and (m.updated_at>=last_refresh or o.settled_at>=last_refresh)
  union select d.screening_id from public.icash_deal_files d join public.icash_seller_email_openers a on a.deal_id=d.id and a.account_id=d.account_id
   join public.icash_deal_emails m on m.account_id=a.account_id and (m.id=a.email_id or m.reply_to_id=a.email_id)
   left join public.icash_operation_spend o on o.account_id=m.account_id and o.operation_key='deal-email:'||m.id
   where d.account_id=p_account and (m.updated_at>=last_refresh or o.settled_at>=last_refresh)
  union select d.screening_id from public.icash_deal_files d join public.icash_signing_envelopes e on e.account_id=d.account_id and e.deal_id=d.id
   where d.account_id=p_account and e.updated_at>=last_refresh
  union select c.screening_id from public.icash_owner_contacts c join public.icash_operation_spend o on o.operation_key=c.operation_key and o.account_id=c.account_id
   where c.account_id=p_account and (c.created_at>=last_refresh or o.settled_at>=last_refresh)
 )
 insert into public.icash_opportunity_outcomes(screening_id,account_id,zip,eligible,discovered_at,attempted,responded,interested,opted_out,purchase_signed,response_at,provider_cost_micros,costs_complete,research_source)
 select s.id,s.account_id,left(s.snapshot->'raw'->'data'->>'zip',5),coalesce(s.result->'financialCheck'->>'status'='eligible',false),s.created_at,
  coalesce(v.attempted,false) or coalesce(t.attempted,false) or coalesce(mail.attempted,false),coalesce(v.responded,false) or coalesce(t.responded,false) or coalesce(mail.responded,false),(coalesce(v.interested,false) or public.icash_filter_sms_interest(p_account,s.id)), coalesce(v.opted_out,false) or coalesce(t.opted_out,false) or coalesce(mail.opted_out,false),coalesce(sig.signed,false),greatest(v.response_at,t.response_at,mail.response_at),coalesce(cost.total,0),coalesce(cost.complete,false),s.event_key like 'discovery:%'
 from public.icash_screening_jobs s join changed on changed.id=s.id
 left join lateral (
  select count(*)>0 attempted,bool_or(c.state='complete' and public.icash_call_has_seller_response(c.result)) responded,
   bool_or(c.state='complete' and c.result->'interested'='true'::jsonb and public.icash_call_has_seller_response(c.result)) interested,
   bool_or(c.result->'optedOut'='true'::jsonb) opted_out,
   max(c.completed_at) filter(where c.state='complete' and public.icash_call_has_seller_response(c.result)) response_at
  from public.icash_live_conversations c where c.account_id=s.account_id and c.screening_id=s.id and c.party='seller' and c.conversation_id is not null
 ) v on true
 left join lateral (
  select bool_or(m.direction='outgoing' and m.provider_id is not null and m.state in ('accepted','delivered')) attempted,
   bool_or(m.direction='incoming' and m.state='received' and (m.provider_id is not null or m.event_id is not null)) responded,
   bool_or(m.direction='incoming' and m.state='received' and public.icash_seller_contact_stop(m.body)) opted_out,
   max(m.created_at) filter(where m.direction='incoming' and m.state='received' and (m.provider_id is not null or m.event_id is not null)) response_at
  from public.icash_deal_files d join public.icash_text_threads t on t.deal_id=d.id and t.account_id=d.account_id and t.party='seller'
  join public.icash_text_messages m on m.thread_id=t.id and m.account_id=t.account_id
  where d.screening_id=s.id and d.account_id=s.account_id
 ) t on true
 left join lateral (
  select bool_or(m.id=a.email_id and m.direction='outgoing' and m.state='accepted' and m.provider_id is not null) attempted,
   bool_or(m.reply_to_id=a.email_id and m.direction='incoming' and m.state='received' and m.provider_id is not null) responded,
   bool_or(m.reply_to_id=a.email_id and m.direction='incoming' and m.state='received' and m.provider_id is not null
    and lower(trim(split_part(m.body_text,E'\n',1))) ~ '^(unsubscribe|stop|remove me|please unsubscribe|please stop)[.! ]*$') opted_out,
   max(m.created_at) filter(where m.reply_to_id=a.email_id and m.direction='incoming' and m.state='received' and m.provider_id is not null) response_at
  from public.icash_deal_files d join public.icash_seller_email_openers a on a.deal_id=d.id and a.account_id=d.account_id
  join public.icash_deal_emails m on m.account_id=a.account_id and m.deal_id=a.deal_id and lower(m.recipient)=a.recipient and (m.id=a.email_id or m.reply_to_id=a.email_id)
  where d.screening_id=s.id and d.account_id=s.account_id
 ) mail on true
 left join lateral (
  select bool_or(e.state='completed' and not e.test_mode) signed from public.icash_deal_files d
  join public.icash_signing_envelopes e on e.deal_id=d.id and e.account_id=d.account_id and e.kind='purchase'
  where d.screening_id=s.id and d.account_id=s.account_id
 ) sig on true
 left join lateral (
  select sum(o.actual_micros) filter(where o.state='settled')::bigint total,bool_and(o.state='settled') complete
  from public.icash_operation_spend o where o.account_id=s.account_id and (
   o.operation_key='owners:'||s.account_id||':'||s.id or o.operation_key in
   (select c.operation_key from public.icash_live_conversations c where c.account_id=s.account_id and c.screening_id=s.id)
   or o.operation_key in (select 'text:'||m.id from public.icash_deal_files d join public.icash_text_threads t on t.deal_id=d.id and t.account_id=d.account_id join public.icash_text_messages m on m.thread_id=t.id and m.account_id=t.account_id where d.account_id=s.account_id and d.screening_id=s.id)
   or o.operation_key in (select 'deal-email:'||a.email_id from public.icash_deal_files d join public.icash_seller_email_openers a on a.deal_id=d.id and a.account_id=d.account_id where d.account_id=s.account_id and d.screening_id=s.id))
 ) cost on true
 where s.account_id=p_account and s.state='complete'
  and coalesce(s.snapshot->>'practice','false')<>'true' and coalesce(s.snapshot->>'propertyId','') not like 'practice_%'
 on conflict(screening_id) do update set eligible=excluded.eligible,attempted=excluded.attempted,responded=excluded.responded,interested=excluded.interested,opted_out=excluded.opted_out,purchase_signed=excluded.purchase_signed,response_at=excluded.response_at,provider_cost_micros=excluded.provider_cost_micros,costs_complete=excluded.costs_complete,refreshed_at=now();
 insert into public.icash_opportunity_refreshes values(p_account,now()) on conflict(account_id) do update set refreshed_at=excluded.refreshed_at;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_refresh_ranker_samples(p_account uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare j public.icash_screening_jobs;s icash_ranker_private.samples;first_at timestamptz;interest_at timestamptz;purchase_at timestamptz;closed_at timestamptz;already_converted boolean;
begin
 for j in select q.* from public.icash_screening_jobs q where q.account_id=p_account and q.state='complete'
  and q.event_key like 'discovery:%' and q.result->'financialCheck'->>'status'='eligible'
  and not exists(select 1 from icash_ranker_private.samples x where x.account_id=p_account and x.property_key=md5(q.snapshot->>'propertyId'))
  order by q.created_at,q.id limit 200 loop perform public.icash_capture_ranker_sample(j,true);end loop;
 for s in select x.* from icash_ranker_private.samples x where x.account_id=p_account
  and x.refreshed_at<now()-interval '1 hour' order by x.refreshed_at,x.screening_id limit 200 loop
  select min(e.at) into first_at from (
   select o.dispatched_at as at from public.icash_live_conversations c join public.icash_operation_spend o
    on o.operation_key=c.operation_key and o.account_id=c.account_id
    where c.account_id=p_account and c.screening_id=s.screening_id and c.party='seller' and c.operation_key like 'voice:%' and nullif(c.conversation_id,'') is not null
   union all select m.created_at from public.icash_deal_files d join public.icash_text_threads t on t.deal_id=d.id and t.account_id=d.account_id
    join public.icash_text_messages m on m.thread_id=t.id and m.account_id=t.account_id
    where d.account_id=p_account and d.screening_id=s.screening_id and coalesce(d.terms->>'practice','false')<>'true'
     and t.party='seller' and m.direction='outgoing' and m.state in ('accepted','delivered') and nullif(m.provider_id,'') is not null
  ) e where e.at<=now();
  interest_at:=null;purchase_at:=null;closed_at:=null;already_converted:=false;
  if first_at>=s.observed_at then
   select min(e.at) into interest_at from (
    select c.completed_at as at from public.icash_live_conversations c join public.icash_operation_spend o on o.operation_key=c.operation_key and o.account_id=c.account_id
     where c.account_id=p_account and c.screening_id=s.screening_id and c.party='seller' and c.state='complete'
      and nullif(c.conversation_id,'') is not null and o.dispatched_at between first_at and c.completed_at
      and c.result->'interested'='true'::jsonb and c.result->'optedOut' is distinct from 'true'::jsonb
    union all select public.icash_seller_sms_interest_at(p_account,t.id,first_at,first_at+interval '72 hours')
     from public.icash_deal_files d join public.icash_text_threads t on t.deal_id=d.id and t.account_id=d.account_id
     where d.account_id=p_account and d.screening_id=s.screening_id and t.party='seller' and coalesce(d.terms->>'practice','false')<>'true'
   ) e where e.at between first_at and first_at+interval '72 hours' and e.at<=now();
   select min(o.purchase_at) filter(where o.purchase_at between first_at and first_at+interval '30 days'),
    min(o.closed_at) filter(where o.closed_at between first_at and first_at+interval '60 days'),bool_or(o.purchase_at<first_at) into purchase_at,closed_at,already_converted
    from public.icash_learning_deal_outcomes(p_account) o where o.screening_id=s.screening_id;
  end if;
  if already_converted then first_at:=null;end if;
  update icash_ranker_private.samples set exposed_at=first_at,
   baseline=case when first_at<captured_at then null else baseline end,
   interest=case when first_at>=observed_at and now()>=first_at+interval '72 hours' then (interest_at is not null)::integer end,
   contract=case when first_at>=observed_at and now()>=first_at+interval '30 days' then (purchase_at is not null)::integer end,
   closing=case when first_at>=observed_at and now()>=first_at+interval '60 days' then (closed_at is not null)::integer end,
   refreshed_at=now() where screening_id=s.screening_id;
 end loop;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_refresh_seller_interest(p_account uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with exposures as materialized (
  select a.*,m.created_at started_at,greatest(a.delivered_at,m.last_delivery_at,m.created_at) receipt_at,t.recipient,e.*,
   a.opted_out or coalesce(call_feedback.opted_out,false) contact_opted_out,
   least(public.icash_seller_sms_interest_at(p_account,t.id,m.created_at,greatest(a.delivered_at,m.last_delivery_at,m.created_at)+interval '72 hours'),
    call_feedback.interest_at) interest_at
  from public.icash_seller_opener_assignments a
  join public.icash_text_messages m on m.id=a.message_id and m.account_id=a.account_id and m.thread_id=a.thread_id and m.body=a.body
   and m.direction='outgoing' and m.state='delivered' and m.provider_id is not null
  join public.icash_text_threads t on t.id=a.thread_id and t.account_id=a.account_id and t.party='seller' and t.seller_intake_id is null
  join public.icash_learning_deal_outcomes(p_account) e on e.deal_id=t.deal_id
  left join lateral (
   select min(c.completed_at) filter(where c.result->'interested'='true'::jsonb and coalesce(c.result->>'optedOut','false')<>'true') interest_at,
    bool_or(c.result->'optedOut'='true'::jsonb) opted_out
   from public.icash_call_recordings r join public.icash_live_conversations c on c.account_id=r.account_id and c.operation_key=r.operation_key
   where r.account_id=p_account and r.screening_id=e.screening_id and r.party='seller' and r.to_phone=t.recipient and r.call_sid is not null
    and c.screening_id=e.screening_id and c.party='seller' and c.state='complete' and c.conversation_id is not null
    and c.created_at>=m.created_at and c.completed_at between c.created_at and least(greatest(a.delivered_at,m.last_delivery_at,m.created_at)+interval '72 hours',now())
  ) call_feedback on true
  where a.account_id=p_account and a.learning_context='interest-v2'
   and a.delivered_at between now()-interval '90 days' and now() and greatest(a.delivered_at,m.last_delivery_at,m.created_at)<=now()
 ), keys as (
  select e.thread_id,'text:'||m.id operation_key from exposures e join public.icash_text_messages m
   on m.account_id=p_account and m.thread_id=e.thread_id and m.direction='outgoing'
   and m.created_at between e.started_at and least(e.receipt_at+interval '72 hours',now())
   where m.id=e.message_id or m.provider_id is not null or exists(select 1 from public.icash_operation_spend o where o.account_id=p_account and o.operation_key='text:'||m.id)
  union select e.thread_id,r.operation_key from exposures e join public.icash_call_recordings r
   on r.account_id=p_account and r.screening_id=e.screening_id and r.party='seller' and r.to_phone=e.recipient
   and r.created_at between e.started_at and least(e.receipt_at+interval '72 hours',now()) and r.call_sid is not null
 ), costs as (
  select k.thread_id,coalesce(sum(o.charged_cents) filter(where o.state='settled'),0) cents,
   bool_and(coalesce(o.state='cancelled' or (o.state='settled' and o.charged_cents is not null and o.charged_cents>=0),false)) is true complete
  from keys k left join public.icash_operation_spend o on o.operation_key=k.operation_key and o.account_id=p_account group by k.thread_id
 )
 insert into public.icash_learning_rollups(account_id,domain,context,market,variant,attempts,pending,positive,opted_out,
  contract_trials,contracts,closing_trials,closings,cost_cents,costs_complete)
 select p_account,'seller_sms','interest-v2','*',e.variant,count(*),
  count(*) filter(where e.receipt_at>now()-interval '72 hours' and e.interest_at is null and not e.contact_opted_out),
  count(*) filter(where e.interest_at is not null and not e.contact_opted_out),count(*) filter(where e.contact_opted_out),
  count(*) filter(where e.receipt_at<=now()-interval '30 days'),count(*) filter(where e.receipt_at<=now()-interval '30 days' and e.purchase_at between e.started_at and e.receipt_at+interval '30 days'),
  count(*) filter(where e.receipt_at<=now()-interval '60 days'),count(*) filter(where e.receipt_at<=now()-interval '60 days' and e.closed_at between e.started_at and e.receipt_at+interval '60 days'),
  coalesce(sum(c.cents),0),bool_and(c.complete) is true
 from exposures e left join costs c on c.thread_id=e.thread_id group by e.variant;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_seller_sms_interest_at(p_account uuid, p_thread uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS timestamp with time zone
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select min(reply.created_at) from public.icash_sms_seller_openings opening
 join public.icash_text_messages question on question.id=opening.interest_message_id and question.thread_id=opening.thread_id and question.account_id=opening.account_id
 join public.icash_text_messages reply on reply.thread_id=opening.thread_id and reply.account_id=opening.account_id
 where opening.account_id=p_account and opening.thread_id=p_thread
 and question.direction='outgoing' and question.state in ('accepted','delivered') and question.provider_id is not null
 and reply.direction='incoming' and reply.state='received' and (reply.provider_id is not null or reply.event_id is not null)
 and reply.created_at>question.created_at and reply.created_at between p_start and least(p_end,now())
 and lower(trim(reply.body)) ~ '^(yes|yeah|yep|sure|interested|i am interested|i''m interested|yes i am|yes i am interested|yes, i am interested|yes interested|yes, interested)[.! ]*$'
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_text_messages m where m.thread_id=opening.thread_id and m.account_id=opening.account_id
  and m.created_at>question.created_at and m.created_at<reply.created_at
  and ((m.direction='outgoing' and m.provider_id is not null and m.state in ('accepted','delivered')) or (m.direction='incoming' and m.state='received')));
$function$
